situation: DeFi exploit alert with a quantified loss
current: 🟠 Curve Finance Reentrancy in the vyper pool drained the pool. 12 pools affected; withdrawals paused. Loss: $2.50M • Vector: reentrancy • Chain: ethereum • Severity: HIGH 🔗 https://example.org/a

situation: Scan verdict: honeypot plus mintable supply
current: 🔴 CRITICAL (75/100) — honeypot · mintable
good: Verdict, score and top flags only — nothing competes with the verdict.

situation: Scan verdict: no risk flags found
current: 🟢 LOW (0/100) — no significant risk flags
good: Say 'no flags found', never 'safe' — absence of evidence is not safety.

situation: Scan with almost no data available (1 of 30 factors)
current: ⚪ UNKNOWN — 1/30 factors known
good: Name what is missing and refuse to imply a score you do not have.

situation: Scan verdict: wash trading and a fresh deployer
current: 🟡 MEDIUM (42/100) — wash trading · fresh deployer
good: Two flags, both actionable, no hedging about probabilities.

current:

situation: /start on first contact
current:
👋 Welcome to RugMunch!
I scan tokens for risk before you ape in.
Paste any contract address and I'll score it.
Type /help for commands.
good: One concrete first action in the second line, no brand throat-clearing.

situation: /start on a returning user
current: Welcome back! Type /help to see what's new.
good: Say what actually changed since last visit — or say nothing.

situation: Upstream scanner times out mid-scan
current: 😅 Oops! The scanner tripped over its own feet. Try again in a bit! 🛠️
good: Name the failed upstream, state that nothing was checked, and give a retry window.

situation: User exceeds 10 scans per minute
current: 🛑 Rate limit: 10 scans/min. Slow down and try again shortly.
good: Give the exact limit and the exact wait, not 'shortly'.

situation: Pasted string is not a token address
current: That doesn't look like a token address. Solana addresses are 32-44 base58 chars; EVM are 0x + 40 hex. Nothing was scanned.
good: Always say nothing was scanned — silence reads as a pass.

situation: Community ban for coordinated shilling
current: 🔨 @user removed. Reason: coordinated shilling across 6 groups.
good: Action, reason, evidence count, and how to appeal — in that order.

situation: New account held for moderator review
current: 🛡 New account held for review (score 62). Messages are hidden until a mod decides.
good: Say what is hidden, for how long, and that a human decides.

situation: Ban appeal rejected
current: Appeal denied. The evidence stands: 6 groups, same CA, 4 minutes. You can appeal again in 30 days.
good: Restate the evidence and the next window — no insult, no lecture.
